name: hypes
description: Adapt responses and carry forward only stable, scoped explanation clues at natural commitment points.

interface.shortDescription: Clear, natural responses for what matters now
interface.longDescription: Hypes follows the user's understanding through a conversation and, at task completion, handoff, or a material conclusion, automatically carries forward only stable concept relationships and explanation clues for the exact topic, task, and responsibility. It does not ask whether to save or accumulate intermediate candidates. Hypes keeps no raw conversation and does not reduce the user to a general skill level or personality. Its MCP transport is sessionless, while the private cognitive model remains on this Mac across plugin updates.
defaultPrompt: Use Hypes to make this response clear, natural, and appropriately detailed.
Explain this without repeating what I already understand.
Tell me what materially changed, roughly where the work stands, and what remains.
